name: obsidian-wiki
description: Compiles what you and your coding agent learn into a linked Obsidian markdown wiki through agent skills, a CLI, and an MCP memory server, for developers who want persistent agent memory.

skills.name: Knowledge Ingest
skills.description: Compiles docs, PDFs, chat exports, transcripts, and URLs into interlinked wiki pages, processing only changed sources.

skills.name: Cited Wiki Queries
skills.description: Answers questions from the vault with wikilink citations and produces cited topic briefings and digests.

skills.name: Vault Lint and Dedup
skills.description: Finds broken links, orphans, and contradictions, merges duplicate pages, and cross-links new pages into the graph.

skills.name: Session Memory
skills.description: Injects the owner profile, open threads, and recent changes at session start and captures reusable knowledge at session end.

skills.name: MCP Memory Service
skills.description: Serves a vault over HTTP and MCP with search, read, write, recap, profile, and todo tools behind a bearer key.
